_why: Hand-kept, sourced geography for the Workbench World (docs/WORKBENCH_WORLD_2.md). Public facts only: the 13 Work rows on index.html, addresses as printed on each project's own public site (checked 2026-10-06), symbolic spots where no public address exists. scripts/sync-world.py reads this file and writes js/world/world-data.js. Edit here, then re-run the script.
_coordinates: Every lat/lng is placed by hand from the printed street address against well-known street and landmark positions (no geocoder was available), so each is good to about 300 to 500 m. One tile of the map is 650 m, so that is within a tile of the truth. Snapping to a free tile is done by the script, never here.

geo._coast: Ocean shoreline, north to south, [lat,lng]. Land is east of it. The first and last points sit outside the bbox so the script can close the land polygon. Malibu to Santa Monica, Palos Verdes, San Pedro and Long Beach breakwater, Seal Beach, Huntington, Newport, Corona del Mar, Laguna, the Dana Point headland, San Clemente, Camp Pendleton, Oceanside, Carlsbad, Encinitas, Del Mar, Torrey Pines, La Jolla, Mission Beach, Ocean Beach, Point Loma, Coronado and the Silver Strand to the border. Hand-simplified, good to a couple of km.
geo._waters: Water bodies inside the land polygon: San Diego Bay (the mouth is the straight line Point Loma tip to North Island), Mission Bay, the Los Angeles and Long Beach harbour basin. Subtracted from land.

waters.label: Los Angeles and Long Beach harbor

geo._districts: Three district polygons in lat/lng. Their offshore edges run out to sea along the county lines, so they are bounds for labelling and for the check, not coastlines. Land east of Orange County belongs to no district (inland).

skips: La Vida: Tiger's site also lists La Vida in San Clemente and Little Italy, but lavida.fit itself prints only Carlsbad, so only Carlsbad is a building.
Tiger Hospitality: one building (its own printed flagship address). Its other concepts (Good Enough, the Egg&Out Breakfast Club suite, the La Jolla opening) are not Work rows and get no building.
Lobster Lab and Cosmos Burger: every location their own sites print is a building, including the two Station 8 counters marked coming soon.
Not guessed: CENGO, TrustMeBro, baa atelier and BarFix print no street address and go to the Worldwide pier.
